description: This file contains a middleware class 'ErrorHandlingMiddleware' for handling exceptions and errors globally within an ASP.NET Core application. It intercepts HTTP requests, catches exceptions, logs error information, and returns JSON-formatted error responses.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class responsible for catching exceptions during HTTP request processing, logging errors, and returning JSON error responses.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Entry point for middleware execution; asynchronously invokes the next middleware and handles exceptions.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions by setting appropriate HTTP response status codes and serialization of error messages.
